lastText: The Night EndsA Quiet NeighbourNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 15THE HOUSE AT PURFLEET: STILL UNLETYou close the door of the last cellar and lie down in the last box. Over your head the hunt goes on for a month, and then for another. The old man searches Carfax, and the chapel, and the second house, and each time finds an empty room. Eventually he goes home to Amsterdam. You do not come out until the spring. London is large and has plenty to look at, and it looks at something else. The tellings differ, but they agree on one thing: that whatever he did, he did it in a great hurry, as if he were afraid there would not be enough time. People remember that he wept. A girl from the village says that she saw him, on the night of the storm, standing on the cliff with his hands over his face.
